iOS · Wisconsin Creative · 2026-09-23

Schedule redesign

One master list for everyone. A week jump bar and chips replace the List/Calendar toggle and the filter sheet, and rows drop the bordered card. The list loads week by week: the future is endless, and the past is a deliberate pull.

Top of list

Same fixture scenario, device, appearance and scroll (top). Fixture times are relative to launch, so live states and clock differ by a few minutes.

Today and Tomorrow

Staff fixture user, light mode.

New states (after only)

These states have no direct before equivalent. The old Calendar mode, a month grid above a selected-day list, is shown as the first image for reference.

What changed, and why

Two modes became one list

Was

Calendar mode split the schedule into a month grid plus one day's events.

Now

One master list stays put. The week strip, or the month grid it expands into, just scrolls the list to a day.

Filters were behind a sheet

Was

My Shifts, event type, sport and past events all lived in a large sheet, with a summary bar afterward.

Now

My Shifts and Sport are toolbar toggles; event type is a row of chips; sport and past-event filters show as removable chips.

Cards looked dated

Was

Bordered card, time gutter, venue rail, pin icon and chevron on every row.

Now

Rows sit in rounded day groups under pinned headers, with a venue dot, one meta line, and a bold start time on the right.

Your own work

Was

A blue line with an icon.

Now

The whole row is tinted blue. A Student call time replaces the end time; area and gear move to Event detail and VoiceOver.

Coverage only for staff

Was

Students saw no crew counts.

Now

Everyone sees coverage; it is grey when full and tinted when short.

No open-work count

Was

Trade Board only showed a filled icon; a hand-drawn badge had been clipped by the glass toolbar.

Now

The native toolbar badge shows the count unclipped.

Calendar symbols

Was

The strip and grid drew house, arrow and grid glyphs under each day.

Now

Plain coloured venue dots.

The list dead-ended

Was

The list held every upcoming event and stopped at the last one. Past events needed a staff-only toggle.

Now

Week windows load as you scroll. The future prefetches, and the past, open to every role, sits behind a deliberate pull with a haptic. It replaces pull-to-refresh on this list.

Verification

  • npm run ios:xcode:verify on iPhone 18 Pro Max (UDID): drift, gap audit, simulator build, XCTest, generic device build.
  • ScheduleScreenshotUITests pass, including the new windowed-scrolling test: a flick stops at today, a held pull reveals Sep 14, later weeks load, and the past folds back. EventDetailScreenshotUITests pass too.
  • Full Vitest passes except one test from unrelated in-flight notification work (ios-system-hardening-contract APNs count). New: tests/ios-schedule-windowed-scrolling.test.ts. tsc, verify:docs and git diff --check are clean.

Things to know

  • Fixture captures only. Authenticated device, TestFlight and physical-device testing are still to do, including how the pull threshold feels under a real finger.
  • The fixture harness now filters events and shifts by the requested window, like the routes do.
  • A push deep link to an event outside the loaded weeks still opens 'Event unavailable'. Fetching a single event by id would close that gap.
  • Accessibility text sizes were not reworked (D-053).
